mapper.select: SELECT config_key, config_value, description, version, updated_by, updated_at FROM configurations ORDER BY config_key
SELECT config_key, config_value, description, version, updated_by, updated_at FROM configurations WHERE config_key = #{configKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO configurations (config_key, config_value, description, version, updated_by) VALUES (#{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{description}, 1, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE configurations SET config_value = #{configValue}, version = version + 1, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE config_key = #{configKey} AND version = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO configuration_change_logs (config_key, before_value, after_value, version, operator_id) VALUES (#{configKey}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{version}, #{operatorId})
